purpose: Levels 2 and 3 extension requested after version three source freeze; version three is unchanged

level2.source: Deterministically regenerated version three datasets, same original seeds
level2.threshold: Maximum PP4 over SuSiE signal pairs; conventional >0.8 and independent composite-null calibration across five no-sharing mechanisms. 20 calibration replicates imply strict maximum rank cutoff and average control <=1/21 for each included mechanism, conditional on successful calibration fits.
level2.failures: No credible set is a valid no-discovery. Numerical failures remain in denominators and block that calibrated stratum rather than being removed. Convergence, credible set coverage, purity and causal resolution reported.

level3.model: Individual-level bivariate relationship-kernel REML with genetic and residual covariance; observed continuous/binary working model and exact continuous-liability benchmark
level3.reference: 22 empirical chromosome 22 windows, GRCh37 20.0 to 41.1 Mb; independently resampled as synthetic genome-wide blocks. This is not a real whole-genome African reference panel.
level3.covariates: Intercept and one independently generated standard-normal covariate, removed by orthogonal projection
level3.test: Likelihood ratio for zero genetic covariance with unrestricted residual covariance; calibrated within population sample-size residual-correlation and outcome-mode stratum, two-sided
level3.uncertainty: Information-based intervals are assessed empirically; calibration-aware bootstrap for rejection rates; boundary and nonconvergence retained
level3.interpretation: Genetic covariance/correlation in a synthetic polygenic genome. No Genomic SEM, real shared-genetics discovery, disease-to-disease causation, genome-wide significance calibration or real full-genome LD validation.
